response.justification: Strong, long-tenured generalist software engineer, but the profile is almost entirely web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, D, Ember) rather than embedded networking firmware. The role's hard requirements are largely unmet: no evidence of Japanese language ability (listed languages are English, Romanian, basic German), no Linux kernel analysis or source modification experience, and only brief C/C++ exposure (roughly six months at National Instruments over a decade ago). There is no LAN-switch, L2/L3 networking, MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF, or chip-vendor SDK experience. Despite clear engineering maturity and testing rigor, the gap to this specialized embedded security position is too wide for a mid-senior IC hire.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, progressively senior software engineering experience
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, open-source authorship
Comfortable across many languages and Linux/Docker environments; fast learner
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency (hard requirement)
Minimal recent C and no Linux kernel or embedded firmware work
No networking, switch, or security-protocol domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP)

key_factors.factor: Lack of C/Linux-kernel and embedded firmware experience
No network security or LAN-switch domain knowledge
